deficiencies.description: The lecturer makes a general remark that comparing 'any two things' will reveal differences, but the rewrite narrows this claim specifically to a comparison 'between two species'.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: if you compare any two things, you're going to find differences
deficiencies.rewritePassage: any comparison between two species will reveal differences

deficiencies.description: The hedge 'pretty' has been removed from the scientific claim, presenting the similarity of the molecular processes as definitively clear rather than pretty clear.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: it's pretty clear that, if you like, the molecular processes that are occurring are similar.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: It is therefore clear that the molecular processes occurring are similar.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds 'and so', creating a causal or consequential link between having a problem in differentiation and ending up with a tumour, whereas the source text merely coordinates the two outcomes with 'and end up with'.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: can end up with a problem in differentiation, and end up with a tumor and with that disease.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: can end up with a problem in differentiation, and so with a tumour and with that disease.

Expanding 'hematopoietic' to 'hematopoietic tissues' resolves the ellipsis in the list and preserves the intended meaning without adding unsourced facts.
